title: Administrator checks
description: Golden-task suite of the workbench (aiwb-evals: real jobs through the queue with PASS/FAIL) and the weekly restore test of the nightly database dump (aiwb-backup-check, push to the owner on failure).
isolationReason: the backup check restores the dump from the Drive backup folder into a throwaway local MariaDB (127.0.0.1) and reads production statistics with the host key; evals submit jobs with the host key

secrets.name: aiwb/co-push
secrets.why: host key of the site (core secret, shared with Bridge)
